You are evaluating a software engineering task for repository fastapi/fastapi.

Problem Statement:
🐛 Fix `on_startup` and `on_shutdown` parameters of `APIRouter`

This fixes the issue reported in this comment: https://github.com/fastapi/fastapi/pull/14851#issuecomment-3863896385

```py
from fastapi import FastAPI


def s_start():
    print("SYNC START", flush=True)


app = FastAPI(on_startup=[s_start])


@app.get("/health")
async def health():
    return {"ok": True}
```

Startup event is not called because `APIRouter.on_startup` is set in `APIRouter.__init__` before calling `super().__init__` and  is overridden by `router.__init__` (https://github.com/Kludex/starlette/blob/e5b8a5d200504a2608bed11fe6f66b1d20b9ae2c/starlette/routing.py#L597-L598)

from fastapi import FastAPI
import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def s_start():
    print("SYNC START", flush=True)

def s_shutdown():
    print("SYNC SHUTDOWN", flush=True)

def test_startup_shutdown_events():
    # The issue reported is that on_startup/on_shutdown are not called
    # when passed to FastAPI(on_startup=...) or APIRouter(on_startup=...)
    # because FastAPI inherits from APIRouter.
    
    startup_called = False
    shutdown_called = False
    
    def start():
        nonlocal startup_called
        startup_called = True
        
    def shutdown():
        nonlocal shutdown_called
        shutdown_called = True

    app = FastAPI(on_startup=[start], on_shutdown=[shutdown])

    @app.get("/health")
    async def health():
        return {"ok": True}

    with TestClient(app) as client:
        assert startup_called is True, "Startup event was not called"
        response = client.get("/health")
        assert response.status_code == 200
    
    assert shutdown_called is True, "Shutdown event was not called"

def test_router_startup_shutdown_events():
    startup_called = False
    shutdown_called = False
    
    def start():
        nonlocal startup_called
        startup_called = True
        
    def shutdown():
        nonlocal shutdown_called
        shutdown_called = True

    router = APIRouter(on_startup=[start], on_shutdown=[shutdown])
    app = FastAPI()
    app.include_router(router)

    with TestClient(app) as client:
        assert startup_called is True, "Router startup event was not called"
    
    assert shutdown_called is True, "Router shutdown event was not called"

CHANGE: Move the initialization of `self.on_startup` and `self.on_shutdown` to occur after the `super().__init__` call.

TEST: run `python3 -m pytest tests/test_reproduce_issue.py` (which I created to reproduce the issue) and `python3 -m pytest tests/test_router_events.py`.
